translations.web: His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl. His body is like ivory work overlaid with sapphires.
translations.bsb: His arms are rods of gold set with beryl. His body is polished ivory bedecked with sapphires.
translations.kjv: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl: his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires.
translations.asv: His hands are as rings of gold set with beryl: His body is as ivory work overlaid with sapphires.
